items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I played the piano and he had a band made a movie picture with Josephine Baker, and he was the director, and I was the piano player.

ctx.x: Wait a second. So we're talking about this guy, Joe Jordan and you were saying he went down to Monte Carlo. Now he was a piano player, right?

Piano player -- director of the band. He had the band all down at some theatre on 46th Street. I played the piano and he had a band made a movie picture with Josephine Baker, and he was the director, and I was the piano player. Josephine Baker did -- did I tell you about her?
No, go on, let's hear about that, Tom.
